subject: sargent
name: Ships
title: John Singer Sargent — White Ships (1908), bow and anchor detail

styleSelection.reason: Sargent's marine watercolor builds form through luminous bare cream paper, directional brush lanes across the curved bow and hull planes, and rich dark accents without ink outlines.

families.referenceCue: Sunlit warm-white hull on the right with soft blue-grey horizontal shadow bands
Sweeping curved ship bow in cool cerulean and ultramarine grey-blue shadow
Dark oval hawsehole and warm burnt-sienna rust and chain links curving across the bow
Warm ochre-sienna masts on upper left, cool blue lower hull shadow, and sunlit cream-ochre foreground anchor
Two dark hanging round fenders and diagonal golden-ochre and sienna spar on the right hull
Deep navy-sepia waterline shadow under the bow flare and horizontal turquoise-olive ripples on the lower right
